issues.action: No Form 8825 action. Fix books: reclassify Acct.Exp.Repair + Acct.Exp.Other for RV_RV1 → Acct.Fixed.Tangible.InConstruction.{propNm}. Once placed in service, create Acct.Fixed.Tangible.InService record with placed-in-service date.

AgentF8825_Income.label: Income (Lines 2a-2c)
AgentF8825_Income.summary: Income: Gross rents (Line 2a) = $4,000.00. Other income (Line 2b) = $400.00. Total income (Line 2c) = $4,400.00.

issues.message:
$400.00 of other income detected beyond gross rents.
  • Form 8825 Line 2b is only for rental-related other income (e.g., security deposits applied to rent, lease cancellation fees).
  • Non-rental income does NOT belong on Form 8825 — it flows to Schedule K instead.
  • Confirm this $400.00 is genuinely rental-related before including it on Line 2b.
issues.action: Confirm the $400.00 other income is rental-related before including it on Form 8825 Line 2b. If non-rental, route to Schedule K.
